# 8.css consolidated reference

8.css is a CSS-only library inspired by Windows 8 Start Screen / Modern UI and desktop. It uses semantic HTML and has no required JavaScript runtime. It is an independent community project, not official Microsoft software. The 50 Metro-style SVG symbols are original redrawings based on the clean geometry of Windows 8's visual language, rather than copied system artwork.

## Source of truth
- Edit component modules in `gui/`.
- Edit the source icon sprite in `icons/icons.svg`.
- Run `npm run build` to regenerate `src/8.css`, `dist/8.css`, `dist/gui/*.css`, `dist/icons.svg`, `docs/8.css`, and `docs/icons.svg`.
- Do not hand-edit generated CSS or sprite copies.
- Keep README.md, docs/index.html, docs/components.md, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, and this file synchronized.
- Runtime must remain CSS-only; the sprite is a static SVG asset.

## CSS module order
base.css, tiles.css, buttons.css, forms.css, feedback.css, window.css, app-bar.css, dialog.css, icons.css, responsive.css. The complete `dist/8.css` bundle combines these modules in order. For modular use, load `dist/gui/base.css` first, then required modules. Load `dist/gui/icons.css` for icon utility classes. The SVG sprite is a separate file.

## Package usage
Install from npm using `npm install @flessan/8.css`, then import `@flessan/8.css`. For plain HTML, use `https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/8.css`. The sprite is at `dist/icons.svg`.

```html
<svg class="w8-icon w8-icon--large" role="img" aria-label="Mail">
  <use href="https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/icons.svg#w8-icon-mail"></use>
</svg>
```

Icon-only controls must have accessible names. Use `aria-hidden="true"` on their nested SVGs when the control itself has a label. Since the SVG is external, make sure the `use` element's `href` points at the right file location.

## Public API
Start Screen: `.w8-start-screen`, `.w8-start-heading`, `.w8-start-subtitle`, `.w8-tiles`.
Tiles: `.w8-tile`, `.w8-tile__symbol`, `.w8-tile__label`, `.w8-tile__meta`, `.w8-tile__count`; size modifiers `.w8-tile--wide`, `.w8-tile--tall`, `.w8-tile--large`; colors `.w8-tile--blue`, `.w8-tile--cyan`, `.w8-tile--purple`, `.w8-tile--magenta`, `.w8-tile--green`, `.w8-tile--orange`, `.w8-tile--red`, `.w8-tile--dark`.
Buttons: `.w8-button`, `.w8-button--primary`, `.w8-button--subtle`.
Fields: `.w8-input`, `.w8-select`, `.w8-textarea`, `.w8-field`, `.w8-label`, `.w8-help`.
Choices: `.w8-check`, `.w8-radio`, `.w8-choice`, `.w8-toggle`, `.w8-toggle__input`.
Feedback: `.w8-progress`, `.w8-badge`, `.w8-notice` variants, `.w8-divider`.
Tabs: `.w8-tabs`, `.w8-tab`.
Desktop: `.w8-window`, `.w8-title-bar`, `.w8-title-bar__text`, `.w8-title-bar__controls`, `.w8-window-control`, `.w8-window-control--close`, `.w8-window-body`, `.w8-window-footer`.
App bar and dialog: `.w8-app-bar`, `.w8-app-bar__item`, `.w8-dialog`, `.w8-dialog__body`, `.w8-dialog__footer`.
Icons: `.w8-icon`, `.w8-icon--small`, `.w8-icon--large`, `.w8-icon--xl`, `.w8-icon-button`, `.w8-icon-button--accent`, `.w8-icon-button__label`, `.w8-sr-only`.

## Accessibility boundary
Use semantic controls and accessible names. Keep focus visible, check contrast with custom colors, and respect reduced-motion settings. Icons are decorative unless given an accessible name. CSS styles controls but does not manage state, tab keyboard navigation, window controls, announcements, or focus management.

## Validation
Run `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run build:site`. Checks validate module/bundle parity, CSS brace structure, icon symbol IDs, and parity of generated icon sprite files. They are not a full browser suite.
